:::{#hero-heading}

I am a researcher in structural optimization, with a background in computational mechanics and mathematical optimization.

My recent research focuses on differentiable physics simulation, especially for dynamic objects such as soft robots.

I am also interested in fabrication-oriented design, including 3D and 4D printing technologies that bridge computation and physical realization.

*This is a personal website, and the views expressed here do not represent any organization or institution.*
